description: This file provides date parsing and formatting utilities, including handling of time zones, recurring dates, and integration with the rrule library for recurrence rules.

methods.name: processDate
methods.description: Formats a date with timezone and locale, returning a string with formatted time and date.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Parses a date input and returns a formatted date string or 'No date' if input is null.

methods.name: parseDateTimeWithTimeZone
methods.description: Formats a Date object into a localized string with timezone considerations.

methods.name: parseRecurringDates
methods.description: Generates recurring date strings and Date objects based on recurrence rules and timezone adjustments.
